subject.title: fix(commands): bound reset-hook transcript reads to prevent OOM

question: What bounded prior-message contract should `before_reset` expose across command and Gateway resets?
rationale: The event is a public plugin surface currently carrying complete message arrays; selecting truncation limits or a new representation changes plugin-visible behavior and cannot safely be decided in only this command caller.

options.title: Bound recent messages
options.body: Apply one documented byte and message budget to both reset implementations while preserving the newest useful context.

options.title: Keep complete history
options.body: Preserve current plugin semantics, accept transcript-proportional memory, and narrow this PR's claim to removing direct whole-file string buffering.

options.title: Version streaming access
options.body: Introduce a new reader or transcript-reference payload with an explicit compatibility transition for existing plugins.

recommendation.title: Bound recent messages
recommendation.body: Apply one documented byte and message budget to both reset implementations while preserving the newest useful context.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person to all three decision surfaces: reader behavior, the Gateway sibling implementation, and the exported hook payload.
